bootstrapCheck.method: Stratified map/seed block bootstrap retaining all144 country/swap games within each block

notes: Different opponents are never pooled into one win rate. Historical gates use wins/all, not half-draw score.
The three 635 folds use the same unmodified356 candidate and already registered seeds; they are not unseen seeds for a retuned candidate.
DOG production includes scouts. Net HTNK inventory reduction is not pure combat deaths; target-type kill attribution has relation limits.
30-tick named-role counters and 900-tick snapshots differ. Missing unitDetails remains unavailable, not zero distance.
DESO production, deployments, direct shots/damage and ownerless radiation victims are separate; HARV/CMIN radiation immunity is unchanged.
Capture orders, owner changes and detachments do not prove engineer theft or effective multiple fronts; ownership records lack source.
Smoke and preplaced mechanism fixtures are excluded from every432-game sample.
